Sorry for the wait on this, I know it's been four days. I dug into your account and the short version is: yes, this is a bug, and it's specific to accounts that were migrated from the old billing system before June 2023. There are about 400 accounts affected, yours among them.

What's happening is your renewal date and your billing date got out of sync during the migration, so the system tries to charge you nine days before your plan actually renews, fails silently, and then locks the account. Not great. We have a real fix going out next week, but in the meantime I've manually corrected your dates and applied a credit for the days you lost access.

If it happens again before the fix ships, reply directly to this email, not the general support address, and it'll come straight to me. I'd rather you not have to explain the whole thing again to someone new.
